source.name: Mubadala - Mubadala x SailGP (three-year global partnership announced 2023)

note: Global partner since 2023; title sponsor of the New York and Abu Dhabi Sail Grand Prix and SailGP Inspire; Mubadala-owned Strata Manufacturing (Al Ain) makes F50 hydrofoils and rudders. Renewal status beyond the original three years not published.
